title: Golden Hour Street Selfie
prompt: A candid, arm's-length selfie of a young woman on a city street at golden hour, framed vertically. She has loose, shoulder-length honey-blonde hair with soft face-framing waves and wears a beige trench coat over a dark top with a delicate layered gold necklace. Low, warm sunlight creates a glowing rim light on her hair and a soft peach wash across her skin. Behind her, a tree-lined street with parked bicycles, cream-colored building facades, and a long shadow stretching across the pavement. Shallow, natural depth of field, warm amber, honey, and peach palette, relaxed and sun-kissed, with a nostalgic summer feel typical of a casual social media photo.
